title: Aftermath and Interior
author: Yara Halloran
blurb: Elodie Amberdale, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must ask the question the whole family arranged itself around, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
